# incomplete import target extraction (relative/complex forms)

Import target extraction only collects dotted_name, aliased_import.name, and import_from module_name when present. Relative imports or other import-from forms where module_name is absent will not be captured, which can lead to missing dependency_observed facts.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/python_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.python_analyzer.PythonAnalyzer._import_targets`
